verdict.rationale: E2B documents some bulk operations: the CLI can shut down single or all running sandboxes and list sandboxes filtered by state, the SDK can write multiple files in one call, and plans allow up to 100 concurrent sandboxes for fan-out work. Bulk action beyond these is not documented, and broader fan-out would need custom scripting. Missing for 10: batch creation or execution across many sandboxes, bulk pause/resume or bulk snapshot operations, bulk file reads, and independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.
